blocks.text:
## Three natural regions of Mato Grosso

Your journey starts in Cuiabá and combines the southern edge of the Amazon rainforest, the Cerrado savanna and the wetlands of the Northern Pantanal. In the forest, you walk along trails and go canoeing; in Bom Jardim, you go snorkelling; and in Chapada dos Guimarães, you see rock formations, waterfalls and the sunset from above.

You stay at three lodges: two nights at Jardim d’Amazonia Lodge, two at Park Eco Lodge and three at Araras Eco Lodge. This itinerary gives you time to stay in natural areas and explore on foot, by water and on horseback.

## Price and travel period

| Period | Travellers | Price per person |
|---|---|---|
| Throughout 2027 | 2–3 people | 5,514 USD |

Specific dates and lodge availability are confirmed when booking. The price includes regular transfers, seven nights, meals as specified in the daily programme and activities with an English-speaking guide/naturalist. International and domestic flights are paid separately.
